LESSON: ARTICULATION OF LETTER SOUNDS

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: SPEAKING
Topic 2.7: Articulation of Letter Sounds

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Articulation of Letter Sounds. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Articulate consonants correctly in and out of school.
2. Demonstrate awareness of letter-sound correspondence in class.
3. Take pleasure in articulating vowels and consonants in and out of school. articulating consonant sounds. songs, reciting poems and rhymes relating to consonant sounds. engaged in activities such as sound articulation games e.g. fishing games, skittle games, dice games among others to enhance sound articulation. 21 flash cards, charts, child’s play and daily experiences. recorded clips of letter sounds and illustrations to help them connect letters with their respective sounds. manipulate other interactive programmes that enhance letter sound articulation. upper case (capital) letters and the lower case (small) letters with corresponding sounds.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Articulate consonants correctly in and out of school.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to articulate consonants correctly in and out of school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Demonstrate awareness of letter-sound correspondence in class.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate awareness of letter-sound correspondence in class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Articulation of Letter Sounds.
2. Explain Articulation of Letter Sounds to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Articulation of Letter Sounds.
4. Show that you can: Articulate consonants correctly in and out of school.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Articulation of Letter Sounds. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Articulation of Letter Sounds important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Articulate consonants correctly in and out of school.
2. Demonstrate awareness of letter-sound correspondence in class.
3.
